prompt:
Japanese Milk Bread

Tangzhong:
25g bread flour
120ml whole milk

Dough:
375g bread flour
50g sugar
7g salt
7g instant yeast
120ml whole milk (warm)
1 large egg
55g unsalted butter (softened)

Egg wash: 1 egg + 1 tbsp milk

Make tangzhong: whisk flour and milk in small saucepan over medium heat until thick paste forms (about 3 min). Cool to room temp.

In stand mixer with dough hook, combine flour, sugar, salt, yeast. Add warm milk, egg, and cooled tangzhong. Mix on low 2 min then medium 5 min. Add butter piece by piece, knead 10 min until windowpane.

Bulk ferment 1 hour covered until doubled. Punch down, divide into 4 pieces. Shape into balls, rest 15 min. Roll each into oval, fold in thirds like a letter. Roll into tight cylinder. Place in greased 9x5 loaf pan.

Final proof 45 min until dough rises 1 inch above pan rim. Brush with egg wash.

Bake 350°F (175°C) for 30-35 minutes until deep golden. Internal temp 190°F.

Cool 10 min in pan, then unmold onto wire rack.
